one_liner: Squarespace offers a publicly documented Commerce REST API, self-service OAuth credentials for development, and an official remote MCP server. Taking an OAuth app out of Demo Mode requires review.

auth.notes: OAuth 2.0 is documented for third-party integrations; API keys are also supported.

access.notes: OAuth client IDs and secrets are available immediately for development and testing, but the evidence does not establish whether a developer without a paid subscription can use them against a working Commerce API. Taking an integration live requires review. The documented merchant-site API-key path identifies Commerce Advanced.

api.notes: The documented Commerce API covers read and write operations across core resources.

mcp.notes: The remote server is usable now. Commerce tools currently work only in Claude and ChatGPT.

verdict.rationale: Squarespace documents a Commerce REST API and immediate OAuth credential generation for development, but the evidence does not establish whether a noncustomer can obtain working API access without payment. Taking an integration live also requires review.

evidence.quote: Then, depending on your development needs, authenticate requests by using an API key or OAuth access token.
Squarespace uses OAuth 2.0 to authorize third-party applications to integrate with Squarespace and consume Squarespace APIs.
Generate OAuth client IDs and secrets immediately for development and testing.
When you are ready to take your integration live, simply request a review directly from the app details page in your dashboard.
With Squarespace's Commerce Advanced plan, you can develop a custom application for a Squarespace merchant site.
All Commerce APIs are built on HTTPS and designed with REST principles in mind. Every endpoint uses HTTPS features such as authentication, standard verbs, and standard response status codes.
With Squarespace Commerce APIs, you can build applications to manage the commerce features of a Squarespace merchant site.
All Squarespace plans include our fully-managed cloud hosting, ensuring your website remains available at all times.
The Squarespace MCP server is a remote server. There's nothing to install.
The Commerce tools are currently only available in Claude and ChatGPT.
